Definitions, source and limits

Top contains up to three specifically supported careers. Other contains the remaining careers in the first 12, including discovery options needing confirmation. Lifestyle contains supported careers in that window whose assessed starting pay covers the budget. These lists exactly match the current model chart.

Field memberships overlap. Each model counts once per field within a category in Models reached mode; Profession offers counts every model–profession pair. Categories also overlap.

Zero frequency is not a verdict on a career. Supported options beyond the displayed window, incomplete simulation bindings and unknown preferences remain distinct limitations.
